ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "integration/gate-c-final" ]; then exit 1; fi; previous="${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-HEAD^1}"; if ! git cat-file -e "$previous^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi; if git diff --quiet "$previous" HEAD -- . ../../packages ../../package.json ../../pnpm-lock.yaml ../../turbo.json; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi
